interval_unit: equal-weight birth, paired differences before resampling

branch_phase.sham: all contacts, proposals sampled and clocks matched, writes suppressed
branch_phase.shuffle: final contact only, same intact snapshot/draws before write
branch_phase.shuffle_values: final contact only, relocate numeric payloads with original turnover preserved
branch_phase.precommit: opposite twin after final contact observation, before local commit
branch_phase.readout: opposite twin after common delay, immediately before autonomous action
branch_phase.legacy_no_write: all contacts, candidate selection and disabled-execution sensory receipt retained

feeder_novel: novel physical antipodal mark pair with both marks first demonstrated
